# Superdudes

> Superdudes is an offline-first, punk-smart, culture-driven creative agency: "a creative & production gang that's done it all." The agency makes physical brand experiences: "We solve cool communication tasks by looking people in the eye."

From stadium madness to kitchen talks, chaos-fueled parties to boardroom showdowns: Superdudes operates where real life creates real heat. If it's not physical, it's not Superdudes.

## What we do

- Events
- Special projects
- Brand activations
- Parties and dinner shows
- Theatre
- Stage design
- Pop-up spaces
- Street culture
- Kitchen talks

## Team

- 30 top-tier dudes
- 2,500+ years of cumulative experience

- Polynome: Machines Can Think
- Yango: Yoga with Yasmina
